probe: GET free-text search versus POST scoped identifier resolution
assembly_note: The request used assembly=hg38 and the response selected the hg38 genomic ID/coordinate. The official FAQ's hg38=true example is specifically for interval queries; sending hg38=true with this rsID query did not select hg38. No liftover was performed.
limitations: These calls ran through the local adapter directly, without FastMCP, authenticated platform REST, cache-miss instrumentation, or Agent context.
